# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-14 from the 2026-11-14 Hub dump.

- 3,234,964 models tracked, 930,587 declare a base model, 963,914 parent links, 92,258 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
